# SubtitleMate

> Free subtitle tools that run in your browser. Files are never uploaded. Reads SRT, WebVTT, ASS/SSA, SAMI, MicroDVD (SUB), MPL2 and LRC; writes SRT, WebVTT, ASS, LRC, plain text, Word and PDF.

## Syncing

- [Subtitle shifter](https://subtitlemate.com/subtitle-shifter): Move every cue earlier or later to fix a constant delay.
- [Partial subtitle shifter](https://subtitlemate.com/partial-subtitle-shifter): Fix one section after a cut, scene change, or ad break.

## Fixing and cleaning

- [SRT cleaner](https://subtitlemate.com/srt-cleaner): Remove tags, SDH notes, labels, duplicates, and empty cues.
- [Subtitle validator](https://subtitlemate.com/subtitle-validator): Check timestamps, overlaps, numbering, and empty cues.
- [UTF-8 converter](https://subtitlemate.com/utf-8-converter): Read old encodings and save subtitle text as UTF-8.

## Create and edit

- [SRT editor](https://subtitlemate.com/srt-editor): Make an SRT from text, time it to a video, edit any line.
- [LRC maker](https://subtitlemate.com/lrc-maker): Sync lyrics to a song and save an LRC file.

## Converters

- [Convert to SRT](https://subtitlemate.com/convert-to-srt): Convert VTT, ASS, SSA, SAMI, SUB, MPL2 or LRC to SRT.
- [VTT to SRT](https://subtitlemate.com/vtt-to-srt), [ASS to SRT](https://subtitlemate.com/ass-to-srt), [SMI to SRT](https://subtitlemate.com/smi-to-srt), [SUB to SRT](https://subtitlemate.com/sub-to-srt), [SRT to ASS](https://subtitlemate.com/srt-to-ass)
- [SRT to VTT](https://subtitlemate.com/srt-to-vtt): Create WebVTT captions for HTML5 video and web players.
- [SRT to TXT](https://subtitlemate.com/srt-to-txt): Remove timings and export the dialogue as a TXT file.
- [SRT to Word](https://subtitlemate.com/srt-to-word): Make an editable .docx transcript.
- [Convert to PDF](https://subtitlemate.com/convert-subtitles-to-pdf): Make a printable PDF transcript.

## Merge and style

- [Subtitle merger](https://subtitlemate.com/merge-subtitles): Merge two languages into one file, or join CD1 and CD2.
- [Subtitle position changer](https://subtitlemate.com/change-subtitle-position): Move subtitles to the top, middle, or a corner.
- [Subtitle color changer](https://subtitlemate.com/change-subtitle-color): Change the text color of SRT, WebVTT, ASS or SSA subtitles.
